fact: The National Director of Registries and Notaries says more than 145,000 IDPs have been registered since the attacks in the north began, with retroactive birth registration facilitated by the government with UNICEF, IOM and the World Bank.

Cabo Delgado's provincial civil identification service, with partners including IOM and UNHCR, registered about 12,478 ID card applications from families displaced by terrorism in under nine months, produced 5,516 cards and delivered 4,764, per provincial official Rui Chichanga.
